short_rest.msg:
Bardic Inspiration fully recharged.
You may also spend Hit Dice (d8 + CON +1) to recover HP.

rest: Short Rest: Bardic Inspiration returns in full; spend Hit Dice (d8 + CON +1)
Long Rest: Full HP, both spell slots, half Hit Dice restored (1 of 1)
Luck Points reset on a long rest
Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration every time you finish a long rest

bonus: Bardic Inspiration — d6 to an ally within 60 ft
reaction: Silvery Barbs — undo an enemy success
magic: Charm Person — WIS save DC 15
Faerie Fire — advantage for everyone

reminders: Bardic Inspiration is a Bonus Action — 5 uses, and they all come back on a short rest. Spend them freely.
Resourceful: you gain Heroic Inspiration after every long rest. Spend the old one before you sleep.
Lucky: 2 Luck Points — advantage on one of your d20 tests, or disadvantage on an attack aimed at you.
Spell save DC 15 is unusually high for level 1. Lead with Charm Person, Command or Tasha's Hideous Laughter.
Only two level-1 slots. Healing Word is a Bonus Action, so you can still attack the same turn.
Deception +7 and Performance +7 are your best checks by a mile — talk first.
